orders.text:
WPSS No. 576 of 2017
Hon’ble Rajiv Sharma, J.
Mr. K.K. Harbola, holding brief of Mr. 
Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the petitioner. 
Mr. Vikas Pandey, Brief Holder for the 
State. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner 
submits that present lis is squarely covered 
by the judgment rendered by the Division 
Bench of this Court in Special Appeal No. 
432 of 2012, decided on 18.03.2013. 
Accordingly, the writ petition is 
disposed of in terms of above cited 
judgment. Respondents are directed to 
consider the case of the petitioner, to grant 
the regular pay scale along with annual 
increments to the petitioner from due dated 
i.e. the date of his initial appointment with 
all consequential benefits within a period of 
eight weeks from today. 
Pending application, if any, stands 
disposed of accordingly. 
(Rajiv Sharma, J.) 
11.04.2017 
Jitendra 
2017:UHC:10949

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
WPSS 576 of 2017
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
 Mr. M.C. Tiwari, Dy. A.G. with Mr. Narain 
Dutt, Mr. Virendra Singh Rawat and Mr. 
Sachin Mohan Singh Mehta, Brief Holder for 
the State. 
 Mr. Gopal K. Verma, Standing Counsel for 
the State of U.P.-respondent nos. 4 & 5/review 
applicant. 
 Review application (MCC 431 of 2020) 
alongwith Delay condonation application (CLMA 
7805 of 2020) has been filed seeking review of 
the order dated 11.04.2017. 
 Learned counsel for the petitioner would 
submit that he may be granted some time to file 
objection to the delay condonation application. 
 To this, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State of U.P. would submit that respondent 
department is apprehending that the petitioner 
will pursue the contempt petition against him. 
 Learned counsel for the petitioner makes 
statement at Bar that he will not pursue the 
contempt proceedings against the review 
applicant till filing of his objections to the delay 
condonation application. 
 In view of the above statement, two weeks’ 
time is granted to learned counsel for the 
petitioner to file objection to the delay 
condonation application as well as review 
application. 
 Till then, it is directed that the petitioner 
will not pursue the contempt proceedings 
against the review applicant. 
 List this matter on 15.10.2020 for hearing 
of the review application. 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
mamta 29.09.2020
